Messages.Author: Charles Richard Robb
Messages.Body:
Can the Rack be moved to other Vamps or must it stay with the original
if it is not stolen

Messages.Author: Charles Richard Robb
Messages.Body:
Are you able to play action modifiers on a reaction?
Can you play action modifiers upon another Meth's acting Vamp if it has
the skill required?
[Can you play a Dawn Operation or Day Operation on another Meth's?]

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cr...@Isis.MsState.Edu (Charles Richard Robb) writes:

>Can the Rack be moved to other Vamps or must it stay with the original
>if it is not stolen

It must stay. Your own minions are prohibited from stealing it, and it
provides no other mechanism for reassignment.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cr...@Isis.MsState.Edu (Charles Richard Robb) writes:

No. No. and No.

p.15:
"Action Modifier Cards: Only the Acting Minion can use these cards, unless
otherwise noted. These can only be used to modify your own minion's actions."

Clear enough?
